title: Kanda 11: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 11.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 11.

verses.original: प्राणाय नमो यस्य सर्वमिदं वशे । यो भूतः सर्वस्येश्वरो यस्मिन्त्सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
verses.transliteration: prāṇāya namo yasya sarvamidaṁ vaśe | yo bhūtaḥ sarvasyeśvaro yasmintsarvaṁ pratiṣṭhitam ||
verses.translation: Salutations to Prana, under whose sovereign sway rests all this universe! Who is the Lord of all that has been, in whom all things are firmly established!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The Prana Sukta: adoration of the supreme Cosmic Breath that animates gods, men, and stars.
